status: NON-EXECUTABLE SHADOW — specification only. No code path may produce a card, forecast, price or wager from V14.
motivation: Ablation shows discrimination is concentrated almost entirely in the starter block (AUC 0.5645 -> 0.5232 when removed). The remaining team-level features are inert. If there is headroom, it is in STARTER DETAIL — not in another estimator.
hypothesis: Replacing the single shrunk-ERA starter summary with recent-form, times-through-order and opponent-handedness detail measurably improves out-of-sample DISCRIMINATION (AUC / Brier resolution) over V13 on the frozen as-of set.

prereg_before_any_fitting.primary_metric: Out-of-sample Brier on expanding-window walk-forward, date-ordered.
prereg_before_any_fitting.inference: Date-block bootstrap (never game-level) + Holm correction across every comparison run.
prereg_before_any_fitting.success_threshold: V14 must beat V13 on the PRIMARY metric with a Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 under the date-block bootstrap. Anything weaker is INCONCLUSIVE, not a win.
prereg_before_any_fitting.failure_is_recorded: A negative result is written up and kept; the disposition set is ADOPT / REJECT / INCONCLUSIVE / DATA_BLOCKED with no indefinite PENDING.

candidate_features_to_build: starter recent form (last 3-5 starts, as-of only)
opponent handedness splits vs the starter's hand
bullpen quality/availability behind the starter (currently invisible to every model)
park x starter batted-ball interaction (park is the 2nd strongest block)
hard_constraints: Strict as-of features only; the training window must remain date < test date.
No market price may ever be an input.
Missing data is flagged and the row excluded, never imputed with an outcome-informed value (R1).
V14 gets a NEW model_id and registry entry; it never writes into V13's identity (R3).
Shadow means shadow: no card, no board, no ledger, no gate movement.
known_data_gaps_that_block_it: features.csv ends 2026-07-19 — only 1475 games with as-of features.
126 outcome labels remain PROVISIONAL (tier-3) pending re-sourcing.
No lineup, bullpen-state or rest data exists in the repo at all — these must be acquired before the hypothesis is even testable.
sample_size_reality: 1054 scored games gives a bootstrap CI on dBrier of roughly +/-0.004. A true improvement smaller than that is undetectable with the data on hand, so a null result will be genuinely ambiguous rather than evidence of no effect.
